preexisting.title: dry-run prints a `pytest not found` line to stderr when pytest is not on PATH
preexisting.detail: `run --dry-run` resolves pytest and prints the error before the decision, then exits 0 with `argv: unknown`. It is not specific to unborn HEAD, because dry-run always resolves pytest. Not caused by this phase.
preexisting.repro: In any repo with no pytest on PATH, run `gerenuk run --dry-run`.

preexisting.title: The production Git spawn inherits the hook's GIT_INDEX_FILE
preexisting.detail: `replay` inside a hook could hit the same hijacked-index problem the repair fixed in tests. The repair report flags it and it is out of this phase's scope.
preexisting.repro: Run `gerenuk replay` from within a pre-commit hook that has GIT_INDEX_FILE exported.
